name: nrf52840-supermini
description: SuperMini nRF52840 board (1MB flash, 256KB SRAM), HSE 32MHz -> 64MHz. LED on P0.15 (some revisions P0.13). Console UART0: TX P0.06 / RX P0.08 @115200. I2C1 SCL P0.27 / SDA P0.26, I2C2 not wired externally. SWD + USB DFU (Adafruit nRF52 bootloader) or SWD flashing.
